sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy and Technology command market leadership, but narrow breadth and fading momentum in Healthcare signal emerging cracks beneath the surface.

Broad market breadth remains severely constrained, with only 2 of 11 sectors showing positive returns across all timeframes (week, month, quarter, half, and YTD). Energy continues to dominate as the undisputed leader, while defensive and rate-sensitive sectors see mixed rotation as Consumer Defensive gains ground while Utilities and Real Estate continue to decay.

Pockets of rotation are surfacing among mid-tier sectors. Consumer Defensive and Financials are climbing the ranks, while Healthcare is visibly stumbling. Despite maintaining elevated absolute momentum, Healthcare has dropped two rank spots over the past five sessions, highlighting a deterioration in relative strength.

## Strength
- **Narrow Breadth:** Only 2 of 11 sectors are all-green across all evaluated timeframes: Energy (momentum 0.93) and Communication Services (momentum 0.62).
- **Dominant Leadership:** Energy holds the #1 YTD rank with an exceptional 0.933 momentum score, followed firmly by Technology at #2 with 0.750 momentum.
- **Top-Tier Stability:** Both Energy and Technology held their rank positions over the last 5 sessions, showing zero spot deterioration.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Top 5-Day Improvers:** Consumer Defensive improved +2 spots to rank 6 (momentum 0.433), while Financials gained +1 spot to rank 5 (momentum 0.667) and Communication Services rose +1 spot to rank 9 (momentum 0.617).
- **Sharpest Decliners:** Healthcare suffered the largest drop, falling -2 spots to rank 7 (momentum 0.633), while Real Estate slipped -1 spot to rank 8 (momentum 0.267) and Utilities fell -1 spot to rank 10 (momentum 0.067).
- **Basement Laggards:** Utilities (0.067 momentum, rank 10) and Consumer Cyclical (0.267 momentum, rank 11) remain the absolute weakest sectors in the market.

## Divergences
- **Fading Relative Strength:** Healthcare presents an early-warning divergence with high momentum (0.633) masked by a -2 rank slide over the past 5 sessions.
- **Defensive Disconnect:** While Consumer Defensive surged +2 spots, traditional defensive peer Utilities sits in full retreat with a bottom-tier 0.067 momentum score and a -1 rank drop.

rotation_phase.label: Late Cycle
rotation_phase.reasoning: Energy is the dominant leader with top momentum across all timeframes while traditionally defensive sectors like Healthcare lag in the bottom half of YTD performance, characteristic of late-cycle dynamics.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy and Marine Shipping maintain dominant broader strength, while rapid multi-session rotations into Consumer Electronics and defensive staples contrast with steep pullbacks across metals and mining.

Market breadth remains narrow, with just 10 of 144 industry groups holding all-green status across all timeframes. Oil & gas segments alongside Marine Shipping continue to anchor leadership boards, reinforced by sustained momentum in financials and diagnostics. Meanwhile, recent velocity is rotating toward Consumer Electronics, Internet Content & Information, and select consumer staples.

Conversely, materials and commodities are experiencing severe short-term distribution, led by sharp declines in Coking Coal, Uranium, and Aluminum. Early-warning signals also point to fatigue in previously strong pockets, with Biotechnology and Business Equipment & Supplies suffering steep rank deteriorations despite high overall momentum scores.

## Strength
- **Narrow Broad Breadth:** Only 10 of 144 groups are positive across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD frames, led by Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.97), Marine Shipping (0.94), and Consumer Electronics (0.93).
- **Persistent Energy Dominance:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing sits at rank 2 YTD (momentum 0.974), alongside Oil & Gas Integrated at rank 8 YTD (momentum 0.885) and Oil & Gas E&P (momentum 0.84).
- **Sustained Multimonth Leaders:** Groups demonstrating sustained rank strength across 1, 3, and 6 months include Financial Conglomerates, Insurance - Reinsurance, Diagnostics & Research, and Health Information Services.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Top Velocity Gainers:** Internet Content & Information jumped +21 spots to rank 69 (momentum 0.74), Tobacco rose +18 spots to rank 40 (momentum 0.73), and Medical Care Facilities added +17 spots to rank 63 (momentum 0.72).
- **Sharp Distribution in Resources:** Coking Coal dropped -31 spots to rank 80 (momentum 0.55), Uranium slid -26 spots to rank 101 (momentum 0.24), and Other Precious Metals & Mining shed -21 spots to rank 99 (momentum 0.53).
- **Momentum Anchors:** The overall momentum basement is defined by Footwear & Accessories (momentum 0.050, rank 142 YTD) and Airports & Air Services (momentum 0.120, rank 140 YTD).

## Divergences
- **High-Momentum Fades:** Biotechnology slid -19 spots over 5 sessions to rank 47 despite a 0.72 momentum score, while Business Equipment & Supplies lost -17 spots to rank 46 despite a 0.68 momentum score.
- **Healthcare Softening:** Health Information Services fell -7 spots over 5 sessions, diverging from its high 0.73 momentum reading.
- **Emerging Low-Momentum Rebounds:** Discount Stores surged +14 spots over 5 days with a momentum score of just 0.46, accompanied by Grocery Stores jumping +11 spots with a 0.39 momentum score.
